content.text: **Summary**: I resolved ticket T-2009 by investigating the pricing-engine crash loop. The issue is not a Kubernetes problem - it's an application bug triggered by a new pricing rule. The pricing-engine pods panic with an index out of range error (exit code 2) when compiling the "BF-2026-STACKED" rule due to an off-by-one bug in the tier lookup logic. I provided the ticket owner with the root cause, evidence from pod logs, and a recommended fix: either temporarily disable the problematic rule in pricing-rules-admin or deploy a fixed version of pricing-engine.
